# Cedric Stanhope & Nora

- [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) — Friend of — [Nora](../character/nora.md) — imaginary rock person companion · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> A letter from [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) details his imaginary, whimsical companions near the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md), and the [Twin Sailors](../codex/places.md#twin-sailors). He describes fantastic adventures with them, such as sailing into the moon and traveling into the sunset.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P44](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0044)_

> During a cold winter at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER
